content.title: Who Won 'Jeopardy' Today? Plus Final Jeopardy - March 20, 2026
content.text: Key PointsJamie Ding won his sixth consecutive Jeopardy! episode, totaling $162,203 in winnings.Final Jeopardy clue: Joe Theismann joked he shouted "hut" 10,000 times, answer was “What is ‘hut’?”Jeopardy! airs weekdays; episodes stream on Hulu and Peacock. There are three things guaranteed in the world today: Death, taxes, and Jeopardy! being on. Believe it or not, the iconic game show has been on the air for over 60 years (though the modern incarnation we know and love technically debuted in 1984). Under the watchful eye of Ken Jennings (who himself was a record-breaking champion), Jeopardy! puts three people’s trivia skills and reflexes to the ultimate test. And so many of the greats to grace those podiums started by simply watching the show as it aired on weekdays, as millions have done for over half a century. Here’s a spoiler-filled recap of who won Jeopardy! today, plus the answer to Final Jeopardy. 🎬SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 Jamie Ding A week after Jamie Ding arrived on Jeopardy!, he’s still on the show, and making an absolute killing. And his reign will continue into next week, as he became victorious for the sixth episode in a row. Who are the Jeopardy contestants today? David Ley Jordie Hayne Ware is an immersive theater director from Ithaca, New York. Sinecio Morales Sinecio Morales, originally from Rockford, Illinois, is a student. Jamie Ding Jamie Ding is a bureaucrat and law student from Lawrenceville, New Jersey. Going into today, he had won five straight games, winning $131,802. Related: Sam Heughan Surprises ‘Jeopardy!’ Fans With an ‘Outlander’ Category — Can You Answer the Clues? What was Final Jeopardy today? Final Jeopardy today was in the category “Jargon.” The clue: Former NFL QB Joe Theismann once joked that he shouted this word over 10,000 times, but had no idea what it meant.The answer: What is “hut”? In a repeat of yesterday’s performance, Jamie fell behind for the majority of the game, with David taking the lead. The reigning champ came back at the last Daily Double, though, going into Final Jeopardy $4,000 ahead of David. Both Jamie and David got the final answer correct, but Jamie bid over $11,000 to cement the win. He took home $30,401, bringing his total winnings so far to $162,203. Did you get the answer? Sign off in the comments! When is Jeopardy on next? If you’re looking to get your fix more recently, ABC is airing the second quarter-final match of Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars tonight, Friday, March 20, at 8:00 p.m. ET/PT. The evening will feature a showdown between stars Macaulay Culkin, Steven Weber and Jackie Tohn. If you would prefer to wait for the proper civilian version, Jeopardy! will come back Monday, March 23, with a new episode. Check your local listings to find out when to watch, as airtimes may shift due to airings of the March Madness tournament. Where is Jeopardy streaming? Jeopardy! is available on both Hulu and Peacock. Subscribers can enjoy watching new episodes the next day, as well as access a vault of many classic episodes to enjoy at a moment’s notice. Since joining Parade in 2017, Mike has largely covered reality television, becoming one of the go-to journalists for Survivor, Big Brother, The Amazing Race, Dancing with the Stars, Top Chef, The Challenge, and more.
